ProtT5 Hyper-Ubiquitination Classifier

Dataset: High vs Low/Other Ubiquitination K-Sites

Positive (High ubiq): 930 K-sites  |  Negative (Low/Other): 15 730 K-sites

Model: ProtT5-XL-UniRef50 (1024-dim) 15-residue context window centred on each K-site

Preprocessing: re.sub(r"[UZOB]", "X", seq.upper()) → space-separated AAs → T5Tokenizer

No BOS offset: hidden[j, :seq_len] where seq_len = len(seq_trunc)
